text: Wouldn't you like to meet me in the starlight? Wouldn't you like to have my sympathy? Wouldn't you like the conversation? Wouldn't you like the consolation of a little girl like me? I don't care if he's tender, splendor, or if he's short or stout. Any handsome fellow, be his hair jet, black or yellow, I will suit him.
